summary: Equus Total Return, Inc. (NYSE: EQS) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to issue a press release announcing its net asset value (NAV) for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. Net assets were $16.6 million ($1.19 per share), down from $26.5 million ($1.90 per share) the prior quarter, primarily due to a $12.35 million decrease in the fair value of Morgan E P, Inc. (oil price and reserve adjustments) and a $1.6 million increase from CitroTech, Inc. holdings. This is a routine NAV update with no M&A, tender, restructuring, or special-situation catalyst. No board recommendations, advisors, or structural terms are mentioned. What to watch: quarterly NAV trends; no risk-arb angle.
